objective.name: wait_group
objective.description: Defines a group of expected asynchronous results, the condition used to determine satisfaction, the results already received, and the current lifecycle state of the wait.

functional._id_note: Required. Unique identifier of the wait group within the continuity runtime. Assigned by agentic_core when the pilot output is accepted: the pilot never provides it.
functional._condition_note: Required. Determines when the wait group becomes satisfied.
functional._n_note: Required only when condition is n_of_m. Specifies the number of received items required for satisfaction.
functional._expected_note: Optional for the pilot, always present once the output is accepted. Collection of asynchronous results or events expected by this wait group. Absent: agentic_core fills it with the intentions of the same output whose await_response is true.
functional._received_note: Required. Collection of expected items already resolved by durable incoming messages or results. Assigned by agentic_core: it starts empty and only incoming messages fill it.
functional._status_note: Required. Current lifecycle state of the wait group. Assigned by agentic_core: a new group is waiting.
